entries.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that curls. Lying on a decline bench with the head at the high end and the hands holding the top of the bench; the legs start level with the floor with the knees slightly bent, the knees are drawn toward the chest, then the lower spine curls so the pelvis rolls and the hips lift off the bench, a pause, and a slower return. Not drawn: the decline angle is not given by the source, so 20 degrees is a drawing choice.
entries.summary: Head at the high end of a decline bench and hands on its top, draw the knees toward the chest and roll the pelvis so the hips lift off the bench, pause, then return slowly.

frames.caption: Lie on a decline bench with the head at the high end, hold the top of the bench and raise the legs, knees slightly bent, until they are level with the floor.
Draw the knees toward the chest and roll the pelvis so the hips lift off the bench.
Pause at the top. Hold the bench firmly.
Lower the hips and return the legs slowly to the start.
Legs level with the floor again, knees slightly bent.

entries.name: Decline Crunch
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from the side so the legs secured under the ankle roller of the decline bench, the lower back pressed flat against the decline pad across every tick, and the upper-spine curl of the shoulder blades bringing the ribs toward the pelvis without sitting tall all show clearly: curling up to the shortened position, holding at the top, and unrolling slowly.
entries.summary: With the legs secured on a decline bench, the fingertips resting lightly beside the temples, and the lower back pressed into the pad, curl the shoulder blades up to bring the ribs toward the pelvis without sitting tall, hold the shortened position, and unroll slowly.

frames.caption: Secure the legs on a decline bench, lie back with the fingertips resting lightly beside the temples, and press the lower back into the pad.
Curl the shoulder blades up, bringing the ribs toward the pelvis without sitting tall.
Hold the shortened position at the top with the lower back anchored to the pad.
Unroll slowly back down onto the decline bench.
Reset on the pad with the lower back pressed into the bench.
